senses.gloss: m. pl. (Ispe. of סרך; cmp. b. h. שְׂרוֹךְ) plaited chords, as a collect. noun fem. a girdle of strips of cloth (used by washers).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:10:2">Y. B. Kam. X, end, 7ᶜ</cite> <he>הוה עביד ליה חדא א׳ וכ׳</he> used to make for himself one girdle of one kind of wool (so as not to be suspected of using strips of the cloths given him for washing).
